forecast_time_evidence.why_predictive: Offers a crucial interpretive baseline for the STLFSI, suggesting that a move towards or below zero implies reduced stress.

forecast_time_evidence.takeaway: The STLFSI has a long data history dating back to December 31, 1993, serving to measure financial system stress.
